verdict.rationale: Jira ships an AI layer (Rovo), so letting it consume external MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this product. The pack shows no such MCP-client capability, so the verdict is none. The evidence covers only server-side MCP (the official Atlassian MCP server and 'bring context to your AI stack with our MCP') and non-MCP integrations (Marketplace apps, Rovo connecting third-party apps), none of which let Jira plug in and use outside MCP servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
